text.title: TraXem Light - Peace of mind consumption, transparent information.
text.description: TraXem Light is an advanced solution developed to assist businesses in creating and managing QR codes containing their product information. The primary goal of TraXem Light is to increase transparency regarding the origin and details of products, fostering trust among manufacturers, businesses, and consumers. Businesses can easily put together all the useful information about their products, and store them in a simple QR code. When customers scan this code with their phone's camera, they get all the info they need right on their screen. This way, customers can feel more confident about their purchasing decision.

feature.title: Key Features
feature.title1: Product Information Retrieval via QR Code
feature.content1: Consumers scan the QR code attached to the product to access information about its origin and other details, providing a convenient and trustworthy shopping experience.
feature.content2: TraXem Light provides a diverse range of high-quality product information templates, allowing businesses to reuse or customise them to suit various types of products and their specific needs.
feature.content3: TraXem Light enables businesses to design their own information pages for each of their products. By eliminating constraints of predefined templates, businesses can freely innovate to create unique product information templates.

procedure.title: Process
procedure.content1: Enterprises select the information they wish to public and design the interface for the product information page. For example: product images, ingredient composition, production process, usage instructions, certifications, and awards.
procedure.content2: Enterprises select a product template and input information for each production batch, such as batch codes, production dates, and environmental conditions at the time of production. Additionally, businesses can customise additional information they want to share with consumers.
procedure.content3: Print QR codes generated from batch information and apply them to the products.
procedure.title4: Scanning QR Codes and Viewing Information
procedure.content4: Consumers use their phones or tablets equipped with cameras to scan QR codes and view product information that has been publicly disclosed by enterprises.

ecosystem.eco_h2: Let's explore other products within the TraXem group
ecosystem.eco_ct1: TraXem Agri is a software solution applied in the field of agricultural production. With TraXem Agri, producers can easily set up, monitor, and evaluate each season based on available templates, while creating QR codes to optimise the seasonal management process.
ecosystem.eco_ct2: TraXemTM SCM is a powerful supply chain management tool designed to support businesses in tracking product logs and controlling counterfeiting. For consumers, TraXemTM SCM is not just a tool but also an opportunity for them to reliably and conveniently verify the origin of the product.

application.organic-ct: Supports the creation of QR codes on product packaging, enabling consumers to easily scan and access comprehensive information such as product origins, calorie content, organic standards, vegetarian or religious dietary specifications.
application.consumer-product-ct: Allows enterprises and manufacturers to transparently provide product information via QR codes on packaging. This helps consumers understand more about product origins, manufacturing processes, and ingredients, thereby providing peace of mind during shopping.
application.history-ct: All information including introductions, images, audio, video, and multilingual descriptions of historical artifacts can be condensed into a simple QR code. This enhances visitor experiences and maximizes exhibit space efficiency.
application.tourist-ct: Tourists can easily scan and explore information, historical knowledge, and interesting local attractions with multilingual explanations via QR codes. This enhances the tourism experience, providing accurate and detailed information to visitors, promoting local tourism.
application.environment-ct: TraXem Light solution provides detailed information about production processes and environmentally friendly ingredients. This allows businesses to assert the quality and origins of their products, attracting customers interested in sustainable products.
application.infor-safe-ct: TraXem Light QR codes can be used to provide detailed information about hospitality establishments such as restaurants, hotels, and service providers through websites integrated into print materials, menus, and business social media to enhance communication effectiveness.
